Name: Spouse and Roommate Buffs
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]Celebrate your marriage by sharing your knowledge and skills with each other! This mod will give you a buff to your stats with a custom name and description depending on your spouse or roommate, which will stack with food and drink buffs.[/size]

[b][size=5]INSTALLATION[/size][/b][size=3]

Simply download then extract the mod and drop it in your Mods folder.

[/size]
[b][size=5]CONFIGURATION[/size][/b][size=3]

This mod has three configuration options:

[/size][list]
[*][b]Buff Strength: [/b]Choose how strong the spouse/roommate buff is. Options are Weak, Average, and Strong, with Average being around the same strength as food buffs.
[*][b]GenericSpouseRoommateBuff[/b]: Choose which skill will be buffed if you marry another player or marry/roommate a non-vanilla or non-supported mod-added NPC. Set to Off if you don't want to have a buff for your spouse. Options are FarmingLevel, FishingLevel, ForagingLevel, MiningLevel, Attack, Defense, and Off.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Krobus Buff: [/b]Choose which buff Krobus will give you. Oil of Garlic will prevent monsters from spawning, while Monster Musk will attract extra monsters.
[/list]
[b][size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b][size=3]

This mod has added compatibility with the following mods:

[/size]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url]﻿: [/b]If you have multiple spouses, you will receive a separate buff per spouse. It's recommended to set Buff Strength to "Weak" if you intend to marry many people so as not to be overpowered.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿: [/b]If RSV is installed, all of the RSV spouses will also have buffs.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]﻿: If PPAF is installed, platonic partnerships and roommates will also have buffs.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿: If DSV is installed, the buff icons will reflect the appropriate DSV variant being used. Screenshots are taken with DSV installed.
[*][b]Other mod-added NPCs[/b]: If [b]GenericSpouseRoommateBuff[/b] is not set to Off, then you'll get a generic buff of your choice if married to or roommates with a mod-added NPC other than those added by RSV.
[/list]
[b]I will not add compatibility for SVE characters. Do not ask. Any comments asking for it will be deleted.[/b]

Buffs for other custom NPCs may be added in the future depending on time and whether or not I feel like it.
